_comment: skfem helmholtz#5: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh on the non-Hermitian Helmholtz-with-ABC system is silently wrong. Verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 / scipy 1.15.3: MeshTri().refined(2) / ElementTriP1 (25 dofs, stiffness nnz 105), K cast to complex with 5j added to entry (0,1); eigsh(A, k=3, M=M, sigma=0) returns a float64 array with NO exception and NO warning, and its lowest entry is the bare real part of an eigenvalue whose true imaginary part is several units -- confirmed twice by sparse eigs and dense scipy.linalg.eig. No ArpackNoConvergence and no 'non-Hermitian' text appears anywhere. eigsh on the untouched Hermitian K is accurate to 1e-8, so the fixture is red if either side changes. No measured floats are pinned.
